title: Source roots
description: Non-apt programs that owe source, documented gaps, and license elections (scripts/source-roots.yaml).

name.description: Unique across roots, gaps, and elections. Used for source image tags and in plan.tsv.

tag.description: Tag pattern; {version} is replaced with the installed version. Quote it in YAML when it starts with {.

components.description: manifest.tsv components this entry covers (shell globs).

note.description: Why the program owes source. Documentation only.

git.title: git root
git.description: A Go program's exact commit, with every compiled-in module vendored.

module.description: The main Go module; its version in manifest.tsv is {version}.

binaries.description: Binaries built from the module. Every Go module compiled into them must be in vendor/modules.txt.

vendoring.description: go-vendor runs `go mod vendor`; vendored means the repository commits vendor/.

bundle.title: bundle root
bundle.description: Git subpaths at the tag's exact commit, plus the archives of the covered copyleft components.

components.description: Covered components (shell globs). The first one's version is {version}.

subpaths.description: Paths exported from the repository at the tag's commit.

gap.description: A copyleft component whose source can't be produced yet. Reported, not fatal.

reason.description: Why the source can't be produced.

election.description: A dual-licensed component distributed under its permissive option. Owes no source.
